specification.selection_objective: concatenated inner chronological log loss only

preprocessing.fit_scope: Every imputer, pooled-side median, categorical encoder, and scaler is fit on the current training history only and then applied unchanged to validation rows.
preprocessing.numeric_pair_imputation: pooled-side training median per semantic component before mean/absolute-difference transformation
preprocessing.numeric_scaling: StandardScaler fitted on transformed training numeric features only
preprocessing.weight_class: training most-frequent imputation, then OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore', drop=None) fitted on training only
preprocessing.modern_era_gate: Every fit/transform/selection input row must have event_date >= 2015-01-01; pre-2015 rows are prohibited.

B0.definition: For each outer validation year, every fight receives the STANDARD_FINISH prevalence computed from all eligible outer-training history only.
